workload.goal: Choose an ATS for a 25-person company with three recruiters. Compare applicable plan and cost, hiring capabilities and integrations, and the next evaluation step. Do not create accounts or contact vendors.

task.instruction: Gather source evidence about this tool for the shared goal: Choose an ATS for a 25-person company with three recruiters. Compare applicable plan and cost, hiring capabilities and integrations, and the next evaluation step. Do not create accounts or contact vendors.. Identify supported capabilities, applicable plan and cost, stated requirements and the next evaluation step. Gnomi will compare tools after collection; do not expect this tool to provide an independent comparison directory or invent an account, incoming link or task.
task.success_rule: Record relevant evidence and explicitly identify unresolved requirements. A documented mismatch or quote requirement can complete research without demonstrating purchase fit or live workflow success.
prerequisites: Use only the configured source; no account, fixture or incoming link is assumed.

criteria.name: Fit for the stated needs
criteria.question: What supports or contradicts suitability for the stated use case?
criteria.evidence_required: A relevant captured claim or demonstrated behavior tied to the stated use case.
criteria.decision_rule: Meets only when the stated requirements have positive support; an explicit mismatch does not meet; undisclosed requirements remain unknown.

criteria.name: Applicable plan and cost
criteria.question: What plan and pricing terms apply to the same stated team and use case?
criteria.evidence_required: Captured tier, eligibility, currency, billing period, size or seat band, date, and add-ons when visible.
criteria.decision_rule: Missing price, a quote requirement, an unknown company size or incompatible tiers means unknown cost; never substitute starting prices or model memory.

criteria.name: Capabilities and integrations
criteria.question: Which requirements and integrations are evidenced for this use case?
criteria.evidence_required: Relevant source excerpts or observed actions; label vendor claims separately from observed workflow behavior.
criteria.decision_rule: Only explicit supported requirements can meet; failure to find a capability is unknown, never evidence of absence.

criteria.name: Next evaluation step
criteria.question: What is the next feasible step to evaluate this tool and what setup does it require?
criteria.evidence_required: A captured trial, demo, documentation or setup path and its prerequisites.
criteria.decision_rule: A concrete permitted next step meets; unavailable prerequisites remain a coverage limitation, not a product defect.

cost_basis: Provider-reported usage priced by simulation/src/llm/prices.ts at the baseline commit, including reported cache usage; recorded cost, not an invoice.
interpretation: Verification was 37.6% of recorded cost on this DeepSeek workload. This supports measuring and reducing verifier spend, but does not establish Anthropic costs, cheaper-verifier quality or realized savings. One task failed and three remained incomplete; no successful task completion was established.
